description: This file is a PHP script that generates an error page for the TestLink project, handling different error messages based on input parameters and rendering a template with Smarty.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard object used to hold data in init_args() and init_gui() functions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments, setting up a message based on a 'code' request parameter.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Prepares GUI data with a message, defaulting to the message from args.
